answer: Jetty-trellis mooring bond: each identity locks 70 credits, moors a key-bound trellis frame at a jetty berth. Each epoch it files a tide reading; auditors check it on the nebula tide table, burning bonds on mismatch over 3% or reused serial. First 35, k-th 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented frame carries its owner's key, so a rented-mooring ring fails. Honest agents pay 35 once, keep the bond.
